tools.name: advancedSearchCVE
tools.description: Paginated advanced search across all CVEs in CVEFeed.io. Supports filtering by vendor, product, severity, and other vulnerability filters via query parameters.

tools.name: getVulnerability
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific CVE, including affected products, vendors, CVSS metrics, and CISA KEV status.

tools.name: searchCVE
tools.description: Search CVEFeed.io for vulnerabilities, vendors, and products by keyword or CVE ID. Accepts a CVE ID (e.g. "CVE-2024-1234"), a CVE prefix, or a product/vendor keyword. Returns a small set of matched vulnerabilities, products, and vendors.

query.description: CVE ID, CVE prefix, or product/vendor keyword to search for.
